Honestly? I'd talk less and listen more at the beginning. I came in pretty fast with opinions and plans, and most of the time that was fine, but there were a couple of moments where I think I steamrolled something that needed more room to breathe.

The thing I wouldn't change is the order of priorities. Water, shelter, signal, people — roughly in that order, but never so rigidly that the people part got pushed off the list entirely. I think we got that mostly right.

records.response_pred:
